description: Source code for a GTK widget class 'LabelWithHidingButton' that creates a label with a button that appears on hover or focus, used in the MenuLibre application.

classes.name: LabelWithHidingButton
classes.description: A GTK widget class that combines a label and a button which appears/disappears based on hover or focus events.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing the widget with label, icon, and size, setting up event handlers for hover and focus.

methods.name: _toggle_button_visibility
methods.description: Sets button opacity based on hover or focus state.

methods.description: Callback for mouse entering label area.

methods.name: _leave_notify_cb
